annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/944 of 17 June 2022 laying down rules for the application of Regulation (EU) 2017/746 as regards the tasks of and criteria for European Union reference laboratories in the field of in vitro diagnostic medical devices
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/944 of 17 June 2022 laying down rules for the application of Regulation (EU) 2017/746 as regards the tasks of and criteria for European Union reference laboratories in the field of in vitro diagnostic medical devices
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 164/7
annotation.summary_en: EU implementing regulation setting criteria (staff, equipment, confidentiality, independence) and tasks for EU reference laboratories under the In Vitro Diagnostic Regulation 2017/746, including contracts with notified bodies, performance verification, sample testing, networks and rules of procedure. Not about AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: EU reference laboratories must document staff qualifications, equipment, standards and organisational structure.
Confidentiality and conflict-of-interest policies are required; labs cannot be manufacturers or notified bodies.
Accreditation under EN ISO/IEC 17025 gives presumption of conformity with several requirements.
Opinions on device performance must be delivered within 60 days with reasons.
Sub-networks, proficiency tests and common rules of procedure ensure harmonised work.
